verdict.rationale: The evidence shows only implicit multi-item actions. Users can select which of a notebook's sources the model uses (docs-29). Outputs such as reports, Audio Overviews and Slide Decks are generated across all sources at once (docs-3, docs-19). Deep Research mode gathers web sources into the notebook in one pass (probe-rt-1). Notes can be exported to Docs or Sheets (docs-13), though nothing says this covers many notes at once. The docs describe converting a *single* note to a source, and one user reports manually splitting emails to get them in (comm-6), which suggests weak bulk-ingest tooling. Missing for 10: explicit bulk select/delete/move of sources or notes, documented batch conversion of multiple notes, bulk import of many files, and programmatic or scripted bulk operations.
